summary: No Opole Voivodeship-specific law, enforcement practice, incident, court ruling or institution bearing on trans visitors was identified in the source inventory. The national Polish assessment applies in full.
tangentialFactors: No voivodeship-level adjacent factors were identified: the inventory holds nothing on Opole municipal or regional government declarations, local court practice, regional police conduct, or events in the voivodeship that would alter the national picture.
localsOnly: No resident-facing provision specific to Opole Voivodeship was identified. Trans residents of the voivodeship fall under the national framework, which the country record carries.
outOfScopeNotes: The only source located for this pass is a case report by the Association for Legal Intervention dated 13 March 2024, describing a transgender Vietnamese woman on hormone therapy since 2018 who was placed by a regional court in a guarded centre for male foreign nationals and released after the association applied to a Border Guard post commander. The report documents national immigration-detention practice and names no voivodeship-level court, facility or official; it is carried by the national record. Whether any Opole institution was involved is not stated in the source and remains unresolved.
